title: Notes, Notices, and Messages
ringkas: Menulis pesan singkat yang jelas dan sopan
goals: menulis **catatan, pengumuman, dan pesan singkat** yang jelas
memilih **tingkat kesopanan** untuk pembaca yang berbeda
memuat informasi penting: **siapa, apa, kapan, di mana**

lesson.text: Pesan singkat, catatan, dan pengumuman harus **jelas dan langsung**. Pembaca tidak punya banyak waktu, jadi tulislah informasi penting dengan sopan dan ringkas.

lesson.title: 1. Informasi yang harus ada
table: [[Hi Rani, I'll be 10 minutes late. Please start without me.]]
[[Mom, I've gone to Dina's house. Back at six.]]
[[The science club meets on Tuesday at 3 p.m. in Room 12.]]
[[Dear Ms. Sari, I am writing to ask about ... Thank you.]]

lesson.title: 2. Kesopanan
table: [[Could you please send me the notes?]]
[[I would be grateful if you could send me ...]]

lesson.title: Baca ulang sebagai penerima
lesson.text: Tanyakan: apakah pembaca tahu apa yang harus dilakukan, kapan, dan di mana? Jika tidak, tambahkan informasinya.

items: Sertakan siapa, apa, kapan, di mana.

practice.q: Pilih pesan singkat yang paling jelas:
options: Hi Rani, I'll be ten minutes late. Please start without me.
Hi Rani, I am late because there were many things to do today.
Hello, hello, hello! I will arrive when I can arrive there.
Hi. I will come sometime later, but I do not know when.

practice.q: Pilih catatan untuk Ibu yang paling baik:
options: Mom, I've gone to Dina's house. I'll be back at six.
Mom, I am not at home now, but you can call me later.
Mom, Dina's house is quite far from our house in town.
Mom, I have gone out and I will tell you everything later.
The science club meets on Tuesday at 3 p.m. in Room 12.
The science club meets after school on most days, I think.
Everybody should come to the room on Tuesday if they can.
Room 12 is a big room with many chairs for the club.
Could you please send me the notes?
Send me the notes as soon as you can today, please.
Please give me your notes because I really need them.
I want your notes now so that I can study for the test.
practice.exp: Jawaban yang tepat: **Could you please send me the notes?**

options: Can you send me the notes?
Would you be so kind as to consider sending the notes to me?
I would be most grateful if you could kindly send me notes.
Notes, please! Send them to me as fast as you can!
Dear Ms. Sari, I am writing to ask about the exam date. Thank you.
Hey Sari, what is the exam date? Reply quickly because I need it.
Hello, please tell me the date of the exam when you can.
Dear Sari, exam date? I need to know right now, thanks.
practice.exp: Resmi. Jawaban yang tepat: **Dear Ms. Sari, I am writing to ask about the exam date. Thank you.**

practice.q: Pilih penutup pesan resmi yang baik:
options: Thank you for your help.
See you later, and have a very good evening tonight.
Bye bye! I will talk to you again next time, OK?
Whatever you decide is fine, I do not mind at all.
practice.exp: Jawaban yang tepat: **Thank you for your help.**

practice.q: Pilih pengumuman yang menyebut tanggal dan waktu:
options: The school fair will be held on Saturday, 12 May, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
The school fair is going to be a lot of fun for everyone.
Please come to the fair if you have time to visit us.
The school fair is big and there will be many things there.
practice.exp: Kapan. Jawaban yang tepat: **The school fair will be held on Saturday, 12 May, from 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.**

practice.q: Pilih pesan yang paling sopan kepada atasan:
options: Could I ask for a day off next Friday, please?
I need next Friday off because I have other plans to do.
I will not come next Friday, so please do not expect me.
Please give me next Friday as a day off for my plans.
practice.exp: Jawaban yang tepat: **Could I ask for a day off next Friday, please?**

practice.q: Pilih pesan yang terlalu informal untuk atasan:
options: Hey boss, gotta leave early lol.
Dear Mr. Adi, may I leave early?
Could I leave early?
I would like to ask for permission to leave early.

practice.q: Apa informasi paling penting dalam pengumuman?
options: apa, kapan, di mana
warna kertas dan ukuran huruf pengumuman
nama penulis dan tanggal penulisan saja
panjang kalimat dan jumlah kata kunci
practice.exp: Inti. Jawaban yang tepat: **apa, kapan, di mana**.

practice.q: Apa yang perlu dihindari dalam pesan singkat?
options: informasi yang tidak lengkap
kalimat pendek yang jelas dan langsung
nada sopan yang sesuai dengan pembaca
salam singkat di awal pesan
practice.exp: Lengkap. Jawaban yang tepat: **informasi yang tidak lengkap**.

practice.q: ___ I ask for a day off on Friday, please?
practice.exp: Could I ask. Jawaban yang tepat: **Could**.

practice.q: Susun bagian pesan resmi berikut dengan urutan yang benar.
items: I am writing to ask about the English course.
Could you please send me the schedule and the fee?
I look forward to hearing from you.
practice.exp: Salam, tujuan, permintaan, penutup, tanda tangan.

practice.q: Susun pesan berikut dengan urutan yang benar.
items: The meeting tomorrow is moved to Thursday.
It will start at ten in Room 3.
Please let me know if you cannot come.
